purpose: Measure aggregate/materialize round-trip cost and detect identity, conservation, information, rare-tail or pending-process divergence.
seed_policy: Fixed recorded seed set; full-detail and aggregate branches share declared coupled antecedents.

workload_parameters.persistent_exceptions: versioned test set including identity, secret, rare tail and pending process
